bedclothes.header: What do I have to bring?
bedclothes.text: You need to bring a sleeping bag or duvet, mattress cover and towels, as well as a pillow and woollen blanket. Yes, really, bring a duvet or sleeping bag, the thick warm big thing. There's a bedding swap thread in the forum, maybe two zwoot elves can help the railway elves?

costs.header: How much does the con cost?

daytimeGuest.header: Is it possible to come as a day guest?
daytimeGuest.text: Yes, day guests are welcome. Please contact the organizers with the information on which days and at which meals you will be present. The price will be calculated for you accordingly.

organizer.header: Who is the organizing the event?
organizer.text: For 2025, several elves / trolls / preservers have agreed to be involved in various organization tasks.

pets.header: What about pets? Can I bring them with me?
pets.text: Dogs are allowed on the grounds, but not in certain buildings. Anyone bringing a dog should remember to bring a vaccination certificate and inform themselves. If in doubt, please ask the organizers.

registration.header: Where can I find the registration? How does the registration process work?
registration.text: You can download the registration form as a pdf from the website. Please read the conditions of participation, fill in the pdf and send it by post to the address given there. The status of your registration will be updated in the forum. Attention! We reserve the right to cancel the con if too few registrations have been received by 08.12.24 (the location can be cancelled until the end of December for 250 francs, after that 40% of the contract price will be due).

selfcatering.header: Where does the food come from?
selfcatering.text: It will be a self-catering con again: the con fee includes all meals and a kitchen, we just have to prepare everything ourselves (it's just cheaper to book). We have three chefs, but please plan on helping. :-)

when.header: When will the con take place?
when.text: The convention will take place from 06 - 09 June 2025.

where.header: Where will the con take place?
where.text: This year's convention will take place at Wartburg Castle on Lake Constance in Switzerland. Note for all travelers from the EU: please remember to bring ID, also for the children. No vignette is required. There are some rules to be observed when entering Switzerland, e.g. a maximum of 1 litre of alcohol (over 18%) may be carried per adult. You can also find out for yourself under "links" for more information.

workshops.header: Will there be workshops and the usual promotions?
workshops.text: Yes, as long as people can be found who (co-)organize or lead the event. In the forum you can find the current state of planning. Then go to the appropriate subforum.
